comment: GENERATED by tests/test_ownir_validation_fixtures.py --write; do not edit. Python (ownlang.ownir.load) is authoritative. The BR-D1 strict-door acceptance language for P-022 step 6b, #259 checkpoint 1. Compared across languages: accepted/rejected and, on rejection, the CATEGORY -- never the message text, which is a human-facing presentation aid in the reference.

categories.json: the document is not JSON at all
categories.shape: right place, wrong JSON type or container shape
categories.vocabulary: right JSON type, value outside a closed set
categories.identity: an identity field that is empty or duplicated
categories.location: a source coordinate violating the 1-based contract

cases.name: accept-empty-object
cases.why: the minimal document: absent `ownir_version` means current, and every section is optional

cases.name: accept-explicit-version
cases.why: the current version stated explicitly

cases.name: accept-all-sections-empty
cases.why: every known section present but empty — shape-valid, nothing to check

cases.name: accept-unknown-top-level-key
cases.why: an unrecognised TOP-LEVEL key is additive and accepted; the strict door gates known vocabulary, it is not a closed-world schema

cases.name: accept-subscription-defaults
cases.why: a subscription with no `resource` defaults to 'subscription', which is a known kind

cases.name: accept-every-known-resource-kind
cases.why: all eight known kinds in one document — the acceptance side of the closed vocabulary

cases.name: accept-column-one
cases.why: column 1 is the smallest legal column — the boundary just inside the 1-based contract

cases.name: accept-every-lifetime
cases.why: all three DI lifetimes accepted

cases.name: accept-every-param-effect
cases.why: all four parameter effects accepted

cases.name: accept-param-effect-absent
cases.why: `effect` is optional — absent is not the same as an unknown value

cases.name: json-not-parseable
cases.why: a truncated document is not JSON at all — rejected before any shape check can run
cases.message: <facts> is not valid JSON: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 2 (char 1)

cases.name: root-array
cases.why: the root must be an object, not an array
cases.message: OwnIR root must be a JSON object

cases.name: root-string
cases.why: nor a bare string
cases.message: OwnIR root must be a JSON object

cases.name: root-null
cases.why: nor null
cases.message: OwnIR root must be a JSON object

cases.name: version-mismatch
cases.why: a different schema version makes every later check meaningless
cases.message: OwnIR facts are schema v99, but this core understands v0. Build the Roslyn extractor and the Python core from the same commit — the OwnIR fact vocabulary changed between the version that produced this file and the one reading it.

cases.name: version-string
cases.why: `ownir_version` must be an integer
cases.message: OwnIR 'ownir_version' must be an integer, got '0'

cases.name: version-bool
cases.why: the bool-is-int trap: `True` would otherwise read as version 1
cases.message: OwnIR 'ownir_version' must be an integer, got True

cases.name: version-float
cases.why: a float is not an integer
cases.message: OwnIR 'ownir_version' must be an integer, got 0.0

cases.name: version-null
cases.why: explicit null is NOT the same as absent — absent defaults to current, null is a stated non-integer
cases.message: OwnIR 'ownir_version' must be an integer, got None

cases.name: components-object
cases.why: `components` must be an array
cases.message: OwnIR 'components' must be a JSON array of objects

cases.name: components-of-scalars
cases.why: an array, but not of objects
cases.message: OwnIR 'components' must be a JSON array of objects

cases.name: subscriptions-not-array
cases.why: each component's `subscriptions` must be an array of objects
cases.message: each component's 'subscriptions' must be objects

cases.name: subscriptions-of-scalars
cases.why: …of OBJECTS, not scalars
cases.message: each component's 'subscriptions' must be objects

cases.name: resource-not-string
cases.why: `resource` must be a string before its value can be checked
cases.message: subscription 'resource' must be a string, got 7

cases.name: resource-unknown
cases.why: IR4: a present-but-unknown kind changes routing, so it is rejected at the door rather than mis-routed. A new kind must bump OWNIR_VERSION
cases.message: unknown resource kind 'bogus' — a new kind is a vocabulary change that must bump OWNIR_VERSION (see spec/OwnIR.md §2)

cases.name: resource-empty-string
cases.why: the empty string is present-but-unknown, not absent
cases.message: unknown resource kind '' — a new kind is a vocabulary change that must bump OWNIR_VERSION (see spec/OwnIR.md §2)

cases.name: subscription-type-not-string
cases.why: optional `type`, present ⇒ string
cases.message: subscription 'type' must be a string, got 7

cases.name: subscription-source-type-not-string
cases.why: optional `source_type`, present ⇒ string
cases.message: subscription 'source_type' must be a string, got 7

cases.name: subscription-source-provenance-not-string
cases.why: optional `source_provenance`, present ⇒ string
cases.message: subscription 'source_provenance' must be a string, got 7

cases.name: subscription-ignore-reason-not-string
cases.why: optional `ignore_reason`, present ⇒ string
cases.message: subscription 'ignore_reason' must be a string, got 7

cases.name: column-zero
cases.why: #317: a column is 1-based or absent. `0` is a producer bug, and reading it as 'unknown' would hide the bug while looking correct
cases.message: subscription 'column' must be a 1-based integer or absent, got 0

cases.name: column-negative
cases.why: …and so is a negative column
cases.message: subscription 'column' must be a 1-based integer or absent, got -1

cases.name: column-bool
cases.why: the bool-is-int trap again: `True` would otherwise be accepted as column 1 — a fabricated coordinate
cases.message: subscription 'column' must be a 1-based integer or absent, got True

cases.name: column-string
cases.why: a string column is not a coordinate
cases.message: subscription 'column' must be a 1-based integer or absent, got '3'

cases.name: order-version-before-resource
cases.why: version wins over an unknown resource kind for the same reason
cases.message: OwnIR facts are schema v99, but this core understands v0. Build the Roslyn extractor and the Python core from the same commit — the OwnIR fact vocabulary changed between the version that produced this file and the one reading it.

cases.name: order-root-before-version
cases.why: root-is-object precedes the version gate — there is nowhere to read `ownir_version` from until the root is an object
cases.message: OwnIR root must be a JSON object

cases.name: order-json-before-everything

cases.name: order-components-before-services
cases.why: sections are validated in declaration order: `components` before `services`, so a document breaking both reports components
